subject: Post-call recap: Executive summary & procurement path — HealthBridge
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Tom Reynolds <tom.reynolds@healthbridge.com>, Dr. Priya Iyer <priya.iyer@healthbridge.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 26 Feb 2027 15:02:00 -0800
Subject: Post-call recap: Executive summary & procurement path — HealthBridge

Tom / Priya — thanks again for a productive conversation today. Wanted to capture a short executive-level recap, confirm next steps, and the procurement path we discussed so leadership can align.

Executive summary / business outcomes (what you told us):
- Goal: Enable near-real-time clinical summarization for patient intake and post-consult notes to reduce clinician documentation time by ~40% and improve throughput.
- Success metrics: average latency <200ms for 256-token summaries, 60% reduction in per-summary inference cost vs current vendor, and measurable drop in clinician turnaround time.
- Primary pain points: current vendor latency spikes during peak hours, high cost on long-tail queries, and concerns about PHI handling & auditability.

Risks / blockers we heard:
- Data residency & encryption requirements for PHI (on-prem/VPC preferred for pilot).
- Procurement: need PO and legal review before pilot; procurement point is Asha Kapoor (procurement).
- Exec sponsorship: Priya Iyer agreed to be tech exec sponsor; Tom will be commercial exec champion.

Procurement path / timing:
- Proposed pilot: 3-month pilot focused on inpatient summary workload, scoped to 250 daily concurrent users.
- Next steps for procurement: we will send a pilot SOW & enterprise pricing (attached). HealthBridge to share PO window; Asha indicated typical 3-4 week review with exceptions.

Immediate next steps (action owners):
- Marissa: Share SOW draft, pricing, and TCO for the 3-month pilot (attached).
- Marcus: Schedule technical deep-dive to cover VPC/on-prem options, integration patterns, and latency tuning.
- Evelyn: Pull SOC 2 and secure architecture docs; provide audit log capabilities and retention options.
- Tom / Priya: confirm procurement timeline and primary PO contact (Asha), and confirm pilot start target (we discussed mid-March).

Attachments: redwood-enterprise-pricing-v1.pdf, SOW_draft_HealthBridge_v1.docx, technical-deep-dive-agenda.pdf

If I missed anything or got a detail wrong, please reply with corrections. Otherwise I will follow up with the detailed SOW, pricing summary, and proposed tech-deep-dive timeslots by EOD.

Cheers,
Marissa Cole
Enterprise Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0123

--
Redwood Inference — making inference predictable, fast, and cost-effective for production teams

From: Tom Reynolds <tom.reynolds@healthbridge.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Dr. Priya Iyer <priya.iyer@healthbridge.com>
Cc: Asha Kapoor <asha.kapoor@healthbridge.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 26 Feb 2027 15:37:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Post-call recap: Executive summary & procurement path — HealthBridge

Marissa — thanks for the clear summary. A few clarifications from our side: 

1) Confirmed exec sponsor: Priya Iyer will be the clinical sponsor; I'll be the commercial/tech champion.
2) Procurement: Asha is the procurement lead (cc'd). Our legal team will need to review privacy addenda; can you surface your standard DPA + SOC2 report?
3) Timeline: mid-March pilot start is desirable — can you get the SOW and pricing over by early next week? We'll try to fast-track procurement but expect 2-4 weeks given our internal PO cycles.
4) Technical asks:
   - Can you provide a short architecture diagram for the VPC/offload option and confirm encryption at rest & in-transit?
   - Any hard guarantees for latency at the 99th percentile during pilot? We understand SLOs are typical, but we need ballpark numbers for capacity planning.
   - What's the expected TCO for a 3-month pilot at the scale we discussed (approx. 250 concurrent users, ~100k tokens/day)?

If you can provide the above and the SOC2 report, we'll circulate to legal & procurement and come back with a PO window. Also want to flag that our InfoSec may request an on-site or more detailed pen-test signoff depending on what your security docs show.

-Tom
CTO, HealthBridge

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Tom Reynolds <tom.reynolds@healthbridge.com>, Dr. Priya Iyer <priya.iyer@healthbridge.com>
Cc: Asha Kapoor <asha.kapoor@healthbridge.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 26 Feb 2027 16:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Post-call recap: Executive summary & procurement path — HealthBridge

Tom — appreciate the quick reply and the specific asks. We will deliver the following by Monday:
- Finalized pilot SOW (attached draft now; will update with any scope changes).
- Pricing summary and a modeled TCO for the 3-month pilot at 100k tokens/day (see attached pricing v1).
- SOC 2 report and DPA (Evelyn is assembling; will include audit-log retention options and encryption details).
- Architecture diagram for the VPC/on-prem option and a short note on expected 99p latency under the pilot load (Marcus to lead).

Quick answers:
- Encryption: we support in-transit TLS and AES-256 at rest in our managed VPC offering; for on-prem deployments, keys can be customer-managed (HSM/KMS).
- Latency: typical 95p is under 140ms for the model profile we discussed; 99p depends on burst patterns — Marcus will outline capacity planning and options to keep 99p <250ms for pilot.

I've attached the current drafts and a proposed agenda for the tech deep-dive. Marcus — can you propose two 60-min slots early next week for the deep-dive? Asha / HealthBridge legal — I'll add a link to our DPA/SOC2 in Drive here for review.

HubSpot deal: https://hubspot.company/deal/HB-2027-042
Drive: https://drive.redwood/shared/HealthBridge/SOW_draft_HealthBridge_v1.docx

Thanks — will follow up with the finalized packet by Monday morning.

Best,
Marissa

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 26 Feb 2027 17:10:00 -0800
Subject: Internal: HealthBridge exec recap & owners (do not forward)

Team — quick internal note to capture owners and next actions after the exec call: 

- Marcus Lin: lead for technical deep-dive. Deliverables: VPC architecture diagram, 99p latency modeling for pilot, integration checklist, and a demo plan. Target: have slots for customer next Tue/Wed.
- Evelyn Hart: security & compliance pack. Deliverables: SOC2 report, DPA, data flow diagram showing PHI residency, audit log retention options, and answers for pen-test scope. Target: assemble docs and put in Drive link by Monday EOD.
- Laura Bennett: procurement and commercial. Deliverables: finalize pilot pricing strategy, recommended discount for enterprise pilot, and contract SOW changes to accelerate PO. Coordinate with Asha and legal; aim to be ready to receive PO within 2-4 weeks.

I'll own the SOW and pricing submission to HealthBridge and stay as point for exec follow-up. Please update the HubSpot deal once you have concrete times or docs uploaded.

Thanks — I know timeline is tight; we'll hammer on the packet and keep HealthBridge engaged.

-Marissa
